description: grid_fixtures CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record, tap#365) — the stack this plugin's own tests run in, and the one claim per-plugin CI is allowed to make: that grid_fixtures is correct against the dependencies it DECLARES and nothing else. Install set is grid_fixtures alone (it declares no dependencies); the consumer flips the self entry to editable so the CHECKOUT under test runs, not the pinned revision. Population is empty: this plugin ships no GRIFT to seed. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: every other plugin, all credentials, all required_secrets, and any population step that reaches the network — so a fork can run this lane and a nightly cannot flake on a third party (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-5). Reproduce CI exactly: spawn --from 'git+https://github.com/unified-systems-com/tap-plugin-grid-fixtures@v0.3.1#ci' --dev-plugins grid_fixtures

plugins.note: Self, pinned like any app-of-apps record — the CONSUMER (plugin-ci boot-and-test, or `spawn --dev-plugins grid_fixtures`) substitutes the checkout under test via tap.dev_workspace (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-4). Booting this record unflipped runs the pinned revision.
